userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: apx-control optional feature: agents may offer negotiated rate tables with pushNegotiatedRate (Part 6 §6.6; Annex A APX-CTL-09 and 10).
apx-control optional feature: advisory match candidates at the lane and the matchTicket command (Part 6 §6.7; Annex A APX-CTL-11 and 12).
apx-control optional feature, offered only with negotiatedRates: pushNegotiatedRate may state any amount for the current ticket, with agent and reason required (Part 6 §6.6; Annex A APX-CTL-16).
apx-site-config optional feature: POST /v1/cameras/{id}/views issues short-lived live and snapshot links bound to the agent (Part 26 §26.4).
apx-site-config optional feature, offered only with cameraViews: a view of kind playback over a from/to range within the camera's retention (Part 26 §26.4).
